config.name: Akkadian in the Eastern Mediterranean World
config.blurb: AEMW is an on-going project directed by Jacob Lauinger (Johns   Hopkins University) and Matthew Rutz (Brown University) that aims to bring together lemmatized, searchable editions and translations of archival texts written in Akkadian cuneiform from a wide variety of Eastern Mediterranean sites.
